test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.

Mona took a little time to thought before she gave her consent to the proposal.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the phrase 'time to thought' is incorrect.
 
• The correct phrase should be **'time to think'** to match the tense and context of the sentence.
 
• Infinitive 'to' always take **V1 form of verb** after it. 
 
 
• I've had enough food **to eat.**
 
 

Hence, the correct statement is '*Mona took a little time **to think **before she gave her consent to the proposal*.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When correcting sentences, ensure the verb tense matches the context of the sentence.
 
• In this case,** 'thought' **is a noun ( past participle ), but the context requires a **verb,** hence **'think'** is appropriate.
